title: Go to Melromarc
text: So, the place we headed to was… I thought it might be a run-down village, but we arrived at a religious sect’s settlement with fairly new buildings and lavish decorations. It looks like people are bustling about inside the facility. …? I get the feeling they’ve set up some kind of barrier.
“Oh, looks like they’re here.”
Just as we were planning to sneak in from our hiding spot and wreak some havoc, Ho and Ark are gazing at the settlement from a distance.
“Something smells off.”
“Does it?”
“It’s that, isn’t it? I can tell they’ve set up a barrier to throw off surveillance and the like. That level of protection isn’t really a problem, though. Motoyasu uses stealth skills too, right?”
That’s right. We’ll stack skills and Magic like Cloaking Lance to remain hidden while we operate.
“Well, I guess we’ll leave this to Motoyasu’s expertise?”
“What, are you trying to pass this off to someone else? You’re the one who said there’s someone Motoyasu can’t communicate with, aren’t you?”
“I’ll leave those negotiations to you, Cat-kun.”
In response to Ho-kun’s remark, Ark sighed and stood slightly behind me. This distance… Hmm?
“Alright, I’ll translate what the people who don’t seem to understand me are saying, so let’s get this investigation started.”
“Then let’s go. Liberation Prominence!”
I cast Prominence as a deterrent to show the villagers that the Hero had arrived, then knocked on the village gate.
“Motoyasu Kitamura, the Spear Hero, has come to investigate you lot! Have you been up to anything suspicious?”
“Whoa—so you’re going in with a ‘I don’t trust you from the get-go’ attitude?”
“You could say we’re using the wrong person for the job to begin with… but judging by Naofumi-kun’s demeanor, it feels like we’re throwing Motoyasu-kun right into the thick of it.”
Just as we were talking like that, a guy who looked like a guide came out of the settlement.

“Well, well, what brings the Spear Hero—one of the Four Holy Heroes who saved the world—to this settlement?　It’s true that in the past, there were people here who worshipped that one who falsely claimed to be a god, as well as reincarnated individuals, but those involved have already been dealt with… The sinners you’re looking for are no longer here…”
“We’ve come to inspect whether there really are none left.”
“Is that so… Please wait a moment.”
With that, the guy who seemed to be the guide went back, whispered a report to someone, and returned.
“This way, then.”

And so, we were led along without a hitch. If reincarnated individuals are lurking here, there’s a chance we might fall into a trap, so we need to be extremely careful. When we reached the village square, a few pigs came out to greet us.
“Oink-oink-oink.”
“Oink-oink-oink.”

“‘Welcome, Spear Hero. ‘The reincarnated individuals who once ruled this place have already been dealt with, and this is a settlement for those who have chosen the path of rehabilitation.’ ‘We understand you’re here for an inspection today, but we don’t believe there’s anything in this area that would arouse suspicion,’ they said.”
“We’ll make that judgment after we’ve thoroughly investigated.”
Are those pigs governing this place? From our preliminary research, we know this area was once governed by a noble who was assigned here after the others were dealt with.
“Bring out the noble in charge of this place. This is the one.”
I’ll use the video crystal that my Father gave me to display a photo of the noble entrusted with this place.
“Oink, oink, oink.”
“…‘This is the noble my father was entrusted to. I shall attend to you in my father’s stead, Spear Hero,’ she says… Sigh.”
Ark translated that for me with a sigh. Ho-kun looks like he’s thinking, “Here we go again.”
“Well… how should I put it? There are often souls that are rotten while still alive, but when they’re this rotten, the stench of decay makes your nose curl. Their very core is literally rotten.”
Ho-kun and the others are making a “black declaration.” We need to prod him a little more.
“We have no business with pigs. Hand over your parents immediately.”
“O-oink!? O-o-o-oink-yaa!”
“‘Pig!? You’re calling me a pig!? …No, my father isn’t feeling well at the moment. That’s why I’m acting as his representative,’ is what he says.”
“Didn’t you hear me? I said to come out, even if he’s not feeling well. If need be, let him talk to us even if he’s lying in bed.”

Since they’ve declared themselves “Black,” they’re probably trying to cover up the fact that they’re in a situation where they can’t show their faces to the public—just like those pigs from Takt—by using excuses like “acting as a representative.” So, I’m going to press the issue. There’s no doubt that, if we’re unlucky, someone who isn’t even their parent is impersonating him.
“Bubub…”
“Bubub—”

Just as the figure shown on the video crystal I produced—that pig—was about to introduce himself and stumbled out looking apologetic, Ho-kun called him out. It looks like he’s wearing a disguise mask.
“Bub…”
“I didn’t call for a pig, did I? Where’s your father?”
Since it seemed to be trying to correct me, I immediately moved in close and swiftly slashed its cheek with my spear. Just like that, the disguise melted away with a crack.
“I wonder how effective it is to try to fool people with a disguise?”

“Your work is sloppy, too. You should’ve at least gotten some plastic surgery. Layering lie upon lie—that’s childish, to say the least. I sense a problem with your cultural level or the quality of your people. You might as well win the ‘Evolution Theory Award.’”
Ho-kun is joking. Pigs are indeed foolish. Their contribution to all of humanity is to be executed without leaving a trace.
“More than that, disguising yourself like that against Motoyasu-kun is pointless, given your gender.”
“In that sense, doesn’t that mean Naofumi-kun’s personnel decision was spot-on?”
“Leave it to my Father and everything will be resolved! This Motoyasu carries out his duties exactly as ordered.”
“Ooh, what a loyal dog. Don’t bother me—go pick on Naofumi-kun, the cat, and Filo instead.”
Ho-kun is being considerate of me and worrying about my Father and the others.
“HAHAHA! Ho-kun, you don’t have to hold back. I’m a thoughtful guy, after all.”
I just can’t bring myself to abandon Ho-kun, who looks so lonely with everyone keeping their distance from him.
“Well… I’m on the Light Side too, but when it’s this bright, it’s just too dazzling, isn’t it?”
“Isn’t that one of Motoyasu’s best qualities? Deep down, you’re finding this all pretty amusing too, aren’t you?”
“Well, I guess so…”
While Ho-kun and Ark are chatting like this, I aim my spear at the pig.
“Oink! Oink-oink-oink!”
“Oink-oink-oink!”

“‘You selfish, Trash-like bunch of so-called heroes! If you hadn’t let that one slip through, we wouldn’t be in such a pathetic state! I’ll make you regret barging in here with all that arrogance!’ ‘It’s because of men like you that women can’t shine! If you like persecution so much, just go persecute each other!’ That’s what it said.”

Aren’t you the selfish ones here? The context of that conversation is a mystery. And you’re not a woman—you’re a pig. Don’t get that mixed up. To begin with, we let you off based on testimony that you’d renounced your faith—even though this is a settlement of ex-convicts to begin with—so it’s your fault for piling lie upon lie!
“How foolish. I show absolutely no mercy when slaughtering pigs. Know your place!”
“I don’t know how to put this… but isn’t this the kind of fight where you can’t tell who’s in the right?”
Ho-kun is turning to Ark and speaking, but what on earth is he talking about? Pigs are hideous creatures that act solely to satisfy their own desires!

“Let me tell you this, first of all! If you want to shine that much, just work hard in Melromarc! My Finacée has made it a policy there that hard workers are treated equally, regardless of gender! Well… most pigs are lazybones who crave power but refuse to take responsibility! HAHAHA!”

Lazy Pigs are one thing, but pigs in general are filthy creatures who love nothing more than to laze around and do as they please. That’s why, according to the stories, the nobles of Melromarc have, for generations, left the tedious matters of public duty to the men—merely dictating policy—while the pigs themselves often held the real power behind the scenes. In other words, it’s said that the vast majority of pigs never show their faces in public. Of course, they were the first to show up at parties and run wild, though.

It was the Queen who put a stop to that. She utilized the “Trash’s” influence to implement one reform after another. As a result, it’s said that some men even managed to secure the position of head of their noble houses. We’ve learned that the noble who abused his Big Sister was originally part of the “Trash’s” faction. Apparently, he had distinguished himself in past battles. Furthermore, when the Three Heroes Church was designated a heretical sect thanks to Father’s efforts, the Queen reportedly removed those “pigs” from power as well.
